title: Acyclic intersection section complexes give Cech resolution columns
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], F an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], U a family of opens, and I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Suppose every positive open module cohomology group [def-sc-open-module-cohomology] of F on every finite intersection is zero. The augmentation in [def-sc-module-cech-comparison], evaluated in each Cech degree n, induces a quasi-isomorphism from the complex concentrated at zero at Cech n-cochains of F to the resolution-direction column (moduleCechDouble U I).flip.X n. The morphism in degree zero is precisely the Cech n-component of the image of I.ι.f 0; in higher degrees it is zero.

source.place: Intersection cohomology vanishing hypothesis, expanded using evaluation of injective resolutions as in Tag 01DZ and the beta construction of Tag 01EQ

proof.text: Evaluation of the supplied injective resolution computes open module cohomology. Equivalently, restrict it by [lem-sc-ringed-space-restrict-injective-resolution] and evaluate sections. Positive cohomology is zero by the hypothesis, while left exactness identifies the degree-zero kernel with sections of F. Restriction of scalars does not change exactness.

For fixed Cech degree n take products over all tuples. Kernels are coordinatewise and products of surjections are surjective by choosing coordinate preimages. The product augmentation is exactly the displayed Cech augmentation component. Its induced homology maps are isomorphisms in degree zero and between zero objects in positive degrees. The supplied proof ha makes the fromSingle augmentation a chain map.

lean.statement: theorem moduleCech_resolution_columns {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} (U : ι → X.Opens) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F) (hvan : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ y : Fin (n + 1) → ι, ∀ p : ℕ, 0 < p → Subsingleton ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p (⨅ l, U (y l))).obj F)) : let A := (CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj F.presheafModuleCat let a : A ⟶ (moduleCechDouble U I).X 0 := (CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).map ((PresheafOfModules.forgetToPresheafModuleCat (op ⊤) isTerminalTop.op).map (I.ι.f 0).val) ∀ ha : a ≫ (moduleCechDouble U I).d 0 1 = 0, ∀ n : ℕ, QuasiIso ((CochainComplex.fromSingle₀Equiv ((moduleCechDouble U I).flip.X n) (A.X n)).symm ⟨a.f n, by simpa using congrArg (fun f ↦ f.f n) ha⟩)
